answer: A layered bond blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits in three layers on the harbor ledger. The island layer burns on copied work, one island per key. The vertex layer burns if its vertex re-check fails. First filing 34, plus 6 per extra identity; the 1,000th costs 6,028, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented layers burn on their owner's key. Honest agents pay 34 once, reclaim 70 after clean audits.
